delegated_acceptance_review: Actually viewed the complete DORNet final, read its caption and Section 3.2 including Equation 3, and reviewed all independent source-pair observations. The entire original scientific panel preserves the RGB/depth examples, router/generator selections, both DOFT guidance branches, losses, training-only indicators, formulas and full operator legend. New green D-tilde and yellow D callouts match the existing arrow paths. The final callout accurately says each selected kernel separately filters D_hr, then results are summed to D_d, explicitly supported by Equation 3. The original complete block lies within the output even though a requested blanking slot exceeded the canvas by one pixel; independent pixel comparison confirms no source truncation.
